name: 5-BPDI
summary: An analogue of a-PHP, which has been described as having a similar effect profile, while some users indicating lighter effects and less of the feeling to compulsively redose. There is limited reported use on this drug.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Like α-PHP and other α-pyrrolidinophenones, it is thought to block the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。一般認為它和α-PHP及其他α-吡咯烷苯酮一樣，會阻斷多巴胺與正腎上腺素的回收。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。一般认为它和α-PHP及其他α-吡咯烷苯酮一样，会阻断多巴胺与正肾上腺素的回收。

uses.en: It has been sold as a designer stimulant. There is little reported use.
uses.zh: 它曾作為設計師興奮劑販售，使用紀錄很少。
uses.zhHans: 它曾作为设计师兴奋剂贩售，使用纪录很少。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the α-pyrrolidinophenones such as α-PVP, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, insomnia, agitation, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include psychosis, violent agitation, heart problems, seizures and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮類藥物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、失眠、躁動、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括精神病、激烈躁動、心臟問題、癲癇發作與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮类药物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、失眠、躁动、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括精神病、激烈躁动、心脏问题、癫痫发作与成瘾。

fact.en: It belongs to the pyrrolidinophenone family, whose members all share a pyrrolidine ring, a five-membered ring of four carbons and one nitrogen also found in nicotine.
fact.zh: 它屬於吡咯烷苯酮家族，這個家族的成員都帶有吡咯烷環，也就是由四個碳與一個氮組成的五元環，尼古丁中也有這個結構。
fact.zhHans: 它属于吡咯烷苯酮家族，这个家族的成员都带有吡咯烷环，也就是由四个碳与一个氮组成的五元环，尼古丁中也有这个结构。
